en.headline: Liberal Party re-elects Shiu Ka-fai as chairman and abolishes leader post
en.dek: The party said Shiu continues as chairman while new standing vice-chairmen are named and the previous leader retains a central committee role.
body: The Liberal Party has restructured its leadership, with Legislative Council member Shiu Ka-fai continuing as chairman and the post of party leader abolished.

According to the party, new standing vice-chairmen are Legislative Council members Lee Chun-kong and Chan Hiu-fung. The number of vice-chairmen rises from three to four, comprising Legislative Council member Leung Cham, CPPCC member Si Wai-hung, Eastern District councillor Yuen Kin-chung and Liberal Friends chairman Lam Yau-pik.
Previous party leader Cheung Yu-yan will retain a central committee position. The changes were announced late on Sunday.

zh.headline: 自由黨換屆取消黨魁一職 邵家輝連任主席
zh.dek: 黨方表示邵家輝續任主席，並增設常務副主席，原黨魁保留中委職務。
body: 自由黨領導層換屆，立法會批發及零售界議員邵家輝繼續擔任黨主席，黨魁一職取消。
根據黨方公布，新設常務副主席由立法會議員李鎮強及陳曉峰出任。副主席由三名增至四名，包括立法會議員梁進、港區全國政協施維雄、東區區議員阮建中及自由之友主席林佑碧。
原本擔任黨魁的張宇人則保留中委一職。有關變動於周日傍晚公布。
